artSync.title: Sync Art
artSync.description: Downloads box art for games already cataloged in your library that don’t have it yet, from the public OPLM Art archive (archive.org), matched by exact Game ID — without touching game files.
artSync.checkingArt: Checking for missing and available art...

deleteConfirm.title: Delete title
deleteConfirm.messageSharing: This removes the game file, art, and config for "{{title}}". Sharing is active — deleting a game the PS2 is currently reading can cause the PS2 to fail. This action cannot be undone.
deleteConfirm.message: This removes the game file, art, and config for "{{title}}". This action cannot be undone.

prepareConfirm.title: Prepare device
prepareConfirm.message: This will create the required OPL folders (DVD, CD, PS1, APPS, ART, CFG, VMC) that don’t exist yet, and write a README at the root. Nothing existing will be deleted. Continue?

sources.title: Google Drive
sources.subtitle: Connect your own account to import backups directly from your Google Drive — read-only access.
sources.clientIdHelp: Create a project in Google Cloud Console, enable the Drive API, and generate an "Android" type Client ID (package com.oplforge.mobile + signing SHA-1) — no client secret is needed.
sources.emptyFilesHint: Tap "List files" to see your backups on Drive.

sources.authTimeout: Timed out waiting for Google authorization.

librarySelect.noLibraryHint: Select the folder that represents your OPL library (internal storage, SD card, or a connected USB device) to get started.

clearConfirm.title: Clear app data
clearConfirm.message: This erases the selected library, saved credentials, cached catalog, and the transfer queue. The app will restart. This action cannot be undone.
